name: restful-booker-api-tests
description: Restful-Booker API tests with Postman, Newman, and HTML reports

scripts.test: newman run postman/RestfulBooker.postman_collection.json -e postman/restful-booker.postman_environment.json --folder Health --folder Auth --folder Bookings --folder Negative --reporters cli,htmlextra,json --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/report.html --reporter-json-export reports/report.json
scripts.test:known-bugs: newman run postman/RestfulBooker.postman_collection.json -e postman/restful-booker.postman_environment.json --folder Auth --folder "Known bugs" --reporters cli,htmlextra,json --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/known-bugs.html --reporter-json-export reports/known-bugs.json
